title: New School, New Home
summary: Priya navigates the social challenges of a new school while balancing her family dynamics with her father's night shifts and her grandmother's presence.

people.name: Priya
people.facet_basis: Anxious about making friends, new environment, self-conscious.

goals.description: Establish a peer group at the new school.
Feel comfortable in the new school environment.

private_background: I moved here recently and don't know anyone.
I worry I'll say the wrong thing and get laughed at.
I hope the robotics club is as interesting as it sounds.

people.name: Arun

goals.description: Ensure Priya feels supported despite work schedule.

private_background: I work nights so I miss most of her day.
I try to stay connected via the group chat.
I worry I'm not there enough.

people.name: Meera

goals.description: Help Priya adjust to the new life.

private_background: I am here to support my granddaughter.
I believe in traditional ways of doing things.
I want to know how her school is going.

people.name: Ms. Okafor
people.facet_basis: Runs the robotics club, professional teacher.
private_background: I run the robotics club at school.
I look for interested students to join.

situations.situation: You are at lunch and see a group of students talking. You want to join them.

options.label: Walk over and say hi.
options.success_text: I joined the conversation and felt included.
options.failure_text: I tried to join but they seemed closed off.

options.label: Sit alone and watch.
options.success_text: I sat quietly and observed the group.

situations.situation: You are at the robotics club meeting. You have a question about a circuit.

options.label: Ask the teacher or a peer.
options.success_text: I asked my question and got a helpful answer.
options.failure_text: I asked but felt embarrassed by the response.
options.contact_text: Priya is engaged in her club activities.

options.label: Keep to yourself.
options.success_text: I stayed quiet and focused on my work.
options.failure_text: I missed out on learning by staying silent.

situations.situation: Your father sends a message in the family chat asking how your day was.

options.label: Share details about your day.
options.success_text: I shared my day and felt connected to my family.
options.failure_text: I shared but felt my father didn't fully understand.
options.contact_text: Priya shared her day with me.

options.label: Send a brief response.
options.success_text: I sent a brief response to keep the peace.
options.failure_text: I felt distant from my family after the brief reply.

interventions.description: Ms. Okafor invites Priya to join the robotics club.

priya.text: Ms. Okafor invited me to join the robotics club.

interventions.description: Meera sits down with Priya in the kitchen to ask about school.

meera.text: I asked Priya how school is going.

priya.text: Meera asked me about my school experience.

assumptions: Priya's anxiety is driven by the move and new school.
Arun's worry stems from his work schedule.
Meera's old-fashioned nature influences her interactions.
The robotics club is a key social opportunity for Priya.
The family chat is the primary communication channel between Priya and Arun during the day.
Ms. Okafor is 45 years old as a reasonable age for a senior teacher.
